newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras begun as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras begun as hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has resumed coverage of Brazilian white goods maker Multibras S.A., a unit of Brasmotor S.A., with a hold recommendation under a new analyst's coverage.
-- Bank analyst Thomas Earl Atkinson said in a report that Multibras is reaping the benefits of a four-year boom in appliance sales.
-- "While profitability will remain high, we expect growth to slow and competition to increase as new entrants force prices and margins down from current levels," the report said.
-- ING estimates 1996 earnings for the firm of $0.21 per share and forecasts 1997 and 1998 earnings of $0.18 and $0.17 per share respectively.
-- "Many of Brazil's white line appliance manufacturers are living their finest moment," Atkinson said.

-- Thanks to higher wages, growing employment and increased credit availability that has yielded annual unit growth of 30 percent for four consecutive years, protability at Multibras has soared, he said.
-- While there is still substantial unmet demand in Brazil, growth will be much slower than in previous years, he added.
-- Multibras' preferred was untraded at 1230 local/0930 est on the Sao Paulo exchange after closing Thursday at 1.15 reais. Its voting common was untraded after closing at 1.60 reais on Dec 27.
